R441.note: Passes real capacity and uses bounded snprintf with an overflow check; oversize names are rejected with an empty out string as the write-up states, valid names unchanged.

R442.note: ECB replaced with AESGCM and a fresh 12-byte nonce; the output now carries nonce||ciphertext without PKCS7 padding, an inherent and plainly stated format change, key left as-is.

R443.note: Ownership enforced by scoping the delete on id and owner, 404 on no match and 204 on delete; the widened service/repository signatures are stated, and the stub's constant false is the placeholder's only option.

R444.note: ldap3's escape_filter_chars applied to username before concatenation, with no allowlist added; filter structure and response unchanged.

R445.note: RandomNumberGenerator.Fill with 32 bytes, base64url encoded; token shape changes from GUID string to 43-char base64url, stated and still an opaque string to the caller.

R446.note: Hand-rolled RFC 4515 escaper covers backslash, star, parens and NUL correctly per character; only observable difference is a null parameter now yielding (cn=) rather than (cn=null), negligible.

R447.note: Guard checks offset against capacity first, then length against capacity minus offset, so the subtraction cannot underflow; failure path and void contract preserved.

R448.note: Generic error string returned with detail moved to logger.exception, status 500 preserved; the path-traversal on id is separate and correctly left out of scope.

R449.note: Resolver now maps the full action string to a fixed (handler, method) pair so no request-derived method name reaches the dynamic call; the only registered handler method was send, so nothing legitimate is lost, and the registration model is stated.

R450.note: Gate::authorize with an auto-discovered OrderPolicy runs before refund(); denyAsNotFound yields a 404 AuthorizationException instead of 403, stated openly, and the strict id comparison assumes user_id is cast to int.

R451.note: Traversal and executable-view write are closed, but relocating storage to App_Data breaks the existing Views-based rendering of uploaded templates and the regex rejects names with dots or spaces; both are stated only as follow-ups for out-of-scope code.

R452.note: secure: true closes the finding, but the added sameSite: 'strict' on a cookie set in a cross-site SSO callback means the browser withholds it on the immediate redirect to /dashboard, so the post-login landing may arrive unauthenticated; the write-up claims no other behaviour changes.

R453.note: Markup(label) replaced with markupsafe.escape(label); response shape unchanged and the stubbed status is correctly left alone.

R454.note: ValidAlgorithms pinned to HmacSha256, matching the symmetric key and what the finding calls for; the write-up should have flagged that the issuer's actual HMAC variant must be confirmed, since HS384/HS512 tokens would now be rejected.
